---
name: Markdown
description: "Use when writing or editing Markdown docs, README, notes, or AGENTS-style guidelines. Covers GFM callouts, tables, mermaid, language, and link-not-embed."
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

- Language ko.
- Prefer GFM callouts (`> [\!NOTE]` / `TIP` / `IMPORTANT`), tables, mermaid when structure helps.
- formating: [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](../../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).
- link-not-embed
